plan.notes: Source: HSU official 2026-2027 Degree Plans index, Nursing BS RN to BSN (2026-2027 catalog) PDF, Version 2024/10/7. Header states the plan is 'a suggested program of courses' and 'does not substitute for the HSU catalog'. STRUCTURE NOTE: this is a degree-completion plan, not a freshman-to-senior sequence. The sequenced HSU terms are Fall / Spring / Summer (11+11+11 = 33). The plan additionally lists 21 hours of General Education Requirements, 25 hours of Nursing Educational Prerequisites, and a 41-credit-hour Arkansas Nursing Progression Model 'progression package' that is AWARDED at the end of the final semester (not taken term-by-term; nursing credits completed prior to matriculating are not transcripted). Those requirement blocks are documented here as plan context rather than sequenced semesters: total_credits = 33 is the sequenced HSU coursework only. 21+25+41+33 = 120. All printed term totals (11/11/11) reconcile with the course rows. ELECTIVE placeholders are not used; all sequenced slots are named courses. program_type 'completion': RN-to-BSN degree-completion plan; sequenced HSU terms are Fall/Spring/Summer only.
